content.title: Deutsche Bank's Trading Unit Can Gain Market Share, CFO Says
content.description: Deutsche Bank CFO James von Moltke says the lender's fixed income, currencies and commodities (FICC) trading unit is well-positioned to gain market share. He made the comments in an interview with Bloomberg after the German bank reported fixed-income trading revenue that was 19% higher than the previous year's period.
